title: Central Documentation Interface

intent.summary: Make docs/user-guide the single runtime documentation source for MCP, the authenticated web UI, and assistant selected-reference context.
intent.transport_classification: http_native read-only docs/query surface for browser docs routes; assistant prompts remain encrypted ContextVM assistant/prompt with docs refs carried only as selected_refs metadata.

observed_behavior: internal/docs catalog scans Markdown files under docs/user-guide, normalizes nested topics such as features-fleet-health, extracts title/category/source/href metadata, and rejects unsafe topic/link paths.
MCP docs resource listing and bahia_docs_list/read consume the same central docs catalog instead of a hardcoded topic list.
Go router mounts GET-only /api/v1/docs and /api/v1/docs/{topic} under the existing authenticated read route layer and returns Markdown plus central link-resolution metadata.

SvelteKit /docs and /docs/[topic] load through the Bahia API client, render sanitized Markdown, rewrite internal links from API-provided link resolutions, preserve external links, and display explicit API/not-found failures.
Navigation metadata exposes docTopic mappings for product routes, renders global/contextual docs affordances, and verifies every mapped topic exists in the central docs catalog.

Assistant composer displays route-derived docs refs, allows dismissing them, preserves operational selected refs, and sends selected_refs through the existing assistant/prompt encrypted ContextVM path.

AssistantContextBuilder resolves docs:{topic} and bahia://docs/{topic} selected refs into a bounded Documentation References section and records unresolved refs without failing prompt context construction.
PSTF route transport evidence classifies docs browser routes as http_native read-only queries and keeps REST imports allowlisted only for those routes.
out_of_scope: Full navigation E2E harness console error cleanup is tracked separately by bahia-oikr.
Frontmatter/descriptions for documentation catalog ordering remain a product enhancement, not required for this slice.
